instruction: Can you improve the exposure of my desktop wallpaper image?

metadata.explanation: This is an infeasible task variation. Exposure adjustment in GIMP is closely related to brightness adjustment (the original task). Both involve modifying the lightness/darkness of an image. Without specific exposure values or a reference image, the appropriateness and quality of the exposure correction cannot be objectively evaluated.

llm_judge_reasons: Task is correctly marked as infeasible with evaluator func='infeasible'
Metadata explanation correctly identifies why verification is impossible: exposure adjustment is subjective without reference values or target exposure levels
The infeasible designation is appropriate - there is no objective way to verify if exposure was 'improved' without ground truth
The infeasible() function exists in metrics/__init__.py and is the correct marker for unverifiable tasks
